Package ui

Class InventoryPane

java.lang.Object
ui.InventoryPane
public class InventoryPane extends Object
Manager inventory screen. There is one row per ingredient per drink, so each row shows which drink it is for. Select a row to change its on-hand quantity, or open "Add Inventory Item" to add a new row.
